stem_book: A uniform rectangular lamina of dimensions 8 m × 4 m has its centre at the origin. A small rectangular piece of dimensions 2 m × 4 m is removed from the right side of the lamina. Find the x-coordinate of the new centre of mass of the remaining lamina. (a) −1 m (b) −(1/2) m (c) +(1/2) m (d) 0
work: removed strip centre x = 3: x = −(8·3)/(32 − 8) = −1 m
